The Metabo TKHS 315 C table saw is designed for accurate cutting of squared timber, boards, panels, and other wood-based materials in both workshop and construction site environments. Powered by a 2,000 W induction motor operating on a 220–240 V supply, it delivers a no-load speed of 2,980 rpm with a cutting speed of 50 m/s. The pre-mounted frame and motor simplify setup, while the 315 mm saw blade provides a maximum cutting height of 85 mm at 90° and 60 mm at 45°. With a working height of 850 mm and a maximum rip capacity of 290 mm, this table saw combines practical cutting performance with durable construction for professional and trade applications.

  • Robust powder-coated sheet steel construction with a galvanised table top.

TIG welding capability from as low as 5 amps makes it suitable for precision work, while two arc detection sensors and rapid switching performance help maintain visibility throughout the welding process.

Built with user comfort and versatility in mind, the helmet incorporates stepless sensitivity and delay adjustment so settings can be tailored to individual welding requirements. An integrated grinding mode enables quick changeover between welding and preparation tasks without changing equipment. The lightweight construction and comfortable headgear are intended for prolonged use, while UV/IR protection up to DIN 15 and an optical classification of 1/1/1/2 provide reliable visual performance and protection. A 90 × 40 mm viewing area and 110 × 90 mm cartridge complete a practical solution for everyday workshop applications.

The Weldas Black Bandana Flame Retardant Cotton (23-3615) is designed to provide reliable head protection and comfort for welders and industrial professionals working in high-heat environments. Manufactured from flame-retardant cotton, it helps reduce exposure to sparks, spatter, and radiant heat while remaining lightweight and breathable for extended wear. The adjustable tie-back design ensures a secure, comfortable fit for most head sizes and fits easily beneath welding helmets and safety headgear. Ideal for welding, fabrication, metalworking, and maintenance tasks, this durable bandana offers dependable protection, comfort, and long-lasting performance in demanding workplace conditions.

Features:

  • One size fits all
  • Often used in combination with helmet
  • High comfort and flexibility
  • Sweatband integrated in the front of the Doo-Rag
  • 305 gr./m² flame retardant cotton

Designed for use with polishing wheels and buffing accessories, it effectively removes fine scratches, oxidation, and surface imperfections while enhancing the material’s natural shine. Its consistent formulation ensures even application and reliable polishing performance, making it suitable for workshop, fabrication, and maintenance tasks. Supplied in a convenient 250 g bar, this polishing paste is ideal for professional tradespeople and DIY users seeking high-quality finishing results with minimal effort.

data.product_sub_title: Hex Head Set Screw M10 x 120mm Din 933
data.content:
The DIN 933 M10 x 120mm set screw is a dependable fastening solution for applications requiring a secure, corrosion-resistant threaded connection. Its metric sizing makes it suitable for use with compatible M10 threaded components across mechanical assembly, maintenance, construction, and general industrial projects. The 120mm length provides extended thread engagement where longer fastening reach is required, while the construction offers durability for demanding environments. Designed for practical everyday fastening needs, this hex head screw provides a reliable option for professionals and maintenance teams looking for a standardized metric fastener.

Features:

  • DIN 933 standard for consistent metric fastening specifications.
  • M10 thread diameter with 120mm overall length.
  • Fully threaded shaft for continuous thread engagement.
  • Hexagonal head compatible with standard wrench and socket tools.
  • Metric thread profile supports compatibility with matching M10 nuts and threaded components.
  • Suitable for mechanical assemblies, maintenance work, and industrial fastening applications.
  • Available in different material variants for application-specific requirements.
